notablePrerequisites: Elenda has power equal to or greater than 2 plus the number of times you've cast Elenda from the command zone this game.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {W}.
Choose to return Elenda to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Elenda dies, its second ability triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Vampire creature tokens equal to three times Elenda's power.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Vampire, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Elenda.
Cast Elenda from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Vampire token, adding {B}.
When the Vampire dies, Elenda's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining Vampire token.
Repeat from step 1.
